steps.title: Privilege sensor
steps.what: The Privilege sensor runs on the host, documented as either a Docker container or a Helm-installed daemonset on Kubernetes, and attaches kernel programs to watch process starts.
steps.why: Detecting AI workloads on a host is not enough when an unapproved program must stop running.
